content.title: Indications for Revascularization in STEMI (Patients Without Fibrinolytics)
content.description: This figure provides an algorithm for revascularization in STEMI patients without the use of fibrinolytics, focusing on decision-making based on symptom onset, PCI feasibility, and presence of ischemic symptoms or complications such as cardiogenic shock.

algorithm_sections.additional_condition: Large area or myocardium at risk

sub_conditions.condition: Ongoing ischemia, heart failure, or electrical instability
Totally occluded infarct artery >24 h and no symptoms or severe ischemia

content.recommendation_note: The algorithm does not cover every patient scenario and clinicians are advised to use a Heart Team approach. Lack of data may limit formal recommendations.
additional_study_notes: Studies indicate reduced bleeding with half-dose tenecteplase in patients >75 years of age.
Benefits of early PCI were supported by trials showing reduced rates of death or infarction.
